components.name: OrbitRing
components.description: Floating items in a score ring. Place every item to finish the round.

props.name: items
props.description: Words or images to place

props.name: initialPlacements
props.description: Items already placed when the ring starts (e.g. answers restored after a reload). Read on reset.

props.name: scores
props.description: Inner ring, low to high. Use any number of slices and any text. The middle one is neutral and sits at the bottom; low is on the left, high on the right.

props.name: actions
props.description: Outer ring of flags, any number. Ids must not repeat score ids. Pass [] to hide the ring.

props.name: maxVisible
props.description: How many words float in the circle at once. Default 6. "auto" measures instead: each item's real rendered size (from its text) is checked against the open space in the circle at its current size, and added only if it fits clear of the other words, the center, and the rim. At least one always shows.

props.name: autoCap
props.description: Ceiling for auto mode. Default 12. The fit check still decides whether each word fits.

props.name: settleRing
props.description: Where floating words rest, as a share of the way from the dead zone to the rim. Default 0.62

props.name: maxVisibleOpen
props.description: How many words show at once inside an opened slice. Default 3 × maxVisible (auto: the auto cap)

props.name: maxWidth
props.description: Largest width of the ring, in px. Default 680

props.name: deadZoneSize
props.description: Size of the center drop zone, as a share of the ring width. Default 0.06

props.name: showCounter
props.description: Countdown of words left in the center dead zone. Default true

props.name: showCounts
props.description: How many words sit on each slice. Default true

props.name: showResults
props.description: Lists of placed words under the ring. Default false

props.name: greyUntilHover
props.description: Colored scores stay grey until hovered. Default true

props.name: grain
props.description: Grain on colored slices, 0 to 1. Default 0.28; 0 turns it off

props.name: wrapLabels
props.description: Let long items (whole sentences) wrap onto a few lines in sentence case. Default false

props.name: keyboardShortcuts
props.description: Select a card, then press 1–9 to place it on a score in low-to-high order. Default false.

props.name: autoSelectNext
props.description: After each placement, select the next floating word so it can be answered at once. Default false

props.name: onAutoSelectNextChange
props.description: The taker flipped the auto-select switch in the settings popover

props.name: onShowCountsChange
props.description: The taker flipped "Show counts" in the settings popover

props.name: curveLabels
props.description: Score labels follow the ring, like the action labels, instead of standing upright. Default false

props.name: onCurveLabelsChange
props.description: The taker flipped "Word wrap" in the settings popover

props.name: textSize
props.description: Size of the floating words and the prompt; slice labels stay fixed. Default "md"

props.name: onTextSizeChange
props.description: The taker picked a text size in the settings popover

props.name: onShowTutorial
props.description: Shows a "Tutorial" button in the settings popover; it closes the popover and calls this

props.name: confetti
props.description: A small confetti burst from the center when every word is placed. Default true

props.name: tooltipDelay
props.description: Delay before the center tooltip shows, in ms. Default 200

props.name: sound
props.description: `false` mutes every sound. An object fine-tunes them. Default true

props.name: onPlace
props.description: A word landed on a score or flag, or moved between them

props.name: onReturn
props.description: A word went back to the pool from an open slice

props.name: onComplete
props.description: Every word has a place

props.name: onInteraction
props.description: Drags, opened slices, cancels and the settings popover (see OrbitInteraction)

props.name: prompt
props.description: Question shown near the top of the well; words steer around it. Hidden while a slice is open

props.name: wellLayer
props.description: Decoration for the well (a texture or tone), clipped to the circle and drawn over its fill, under the words and prompt. It takes no pointer input. Fill the box, e.g. `absolute inset-0`

examples.title: scenario · prompt in the well, no flags, restored answer
examples.setup:
const AGREE_SCALE: OrbitScore[] = [
  {
    id: "1",
    label: "Strongly disagree",
    color: "#c07661",
    hoverColor: "#de425b",
  },
  { id: "2", label: "Disagree", color: "#d49e8f", hoverColor: "#e67f83" },
  {
    id: "3",
    label: "Slightly disagree",
    color: "#e4c7be",
    hoverColor: "#f0b8b8",
  },
  { id: "4", label: "Neutral", color: "#f1f1f1", hoverColor: "#cfd8e6" },
  { id: "5", label: "Slightly agree", color: "#d1dacd", hoverColor: "#aecdc2" },
  { id: "6", label: "Agree", color: "#b2c4aa", hoverColor: "#6aaa96" },
  { id: "7", label: "Strongly agree", color: "#93ae88", hoverColor: "#00876c" },
]

const SCENARIO_SETUP =
  "An hour before your big presentation, your manager moves it to a room twice the size and invites the whole department."

const SCENARIO_PROMPT = "How much is this you?"

const REACTIONS: OrbitItem[] = [
  "I rehearse the whole talk again",
  "I message a friend to calm down",
  "I picture it going brilliantly",
  "I ask who exactly is coming",
  "I quietly hope it gets cancelled",
].map((label, index) => ({ id: `r${index}`, label }))

const SCENARIO_SCALE: OrbitScore[] = AGREE_SCALE.map((score) =>
  score.id === "4" ? { ...score, label: "Not sure" } : score
)

const RESTORED: OrbitPlacement[] = [{ itemId: "r0", scoreId: "6" }]
examples.code:
{SCENARIO_SETUP}

{SCENARIO_PROMPT}} initialPlacements={RESTORED} scores={SCENARIO_SCALE} // Every reaction gets a rating; "Not sure" is the neutral way out actions={[]} maxVisible="auto" autoCap={3} // Few words per ring, so they rest closer in instead of out by the rim settleRing={0.15} wrapLabels keyboardShortcuts autoSelectNext={autoSelectNext} onAutoSelectNextChange={setAutoSelectNext} showCounts={showCounts} onShowCountsChange={setShowCounts} curveLabels={curveLabels} onCurveLabelsChange={setCurveLabels} textSize={textSize} onTextSizeChange={setTextSize} wellLayer={ } onComplete={() => setDone(true)} /> { setRound((r) => r + 1) setDone(false) }} />

examples.setup:
const TASKS: OrbitItem[] = [
  "Fix login bug",
  "Write release notes",
  "Update deps",
  "Plan Q3",
  "Review PR",
  "Reply to support",
].map((label) => ({ id: label, label }))

const PRIORITY: OrbitScore[] = [
  { id: "later", label: "Later", color: "var(--info)" },
  { id: "soon", label: "Soon", color: "var(--warning)" },
  { id: "now", label: "Now", color: "var(--destructive)" },
]
examples.code: setSummary( `${placements.filter((p) => p.scoreId === "now").length} to do now` ) } /> { setRound((r) => r + 1) setSummary("Sort the backlog") }} />
